basic_info.description: Step into your serene and elegant retreat nestled in the vibrant heart of Marina. This exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo features tall ceilings and a wealth of upscale amenities. The expansive kitchen is equipped with modern appliances and a formal dining area, perfect for hosting gatherings. Both spacious bedrooms, located at opposite ends, offer luxurious en-suite bathrooms and ample closet space. The formal dining room is ideal for entertaining, complemented by a generous family room that exudes a welcoming ambiance. Hardwood floors, arched doorways, custom molding, and convenient in-unit laundry add to the home's charm.  This building offers additional perks including one-car parking, storage, and a shared yard. Boasting a prime Marina location and elegant Spanish Mediterranean architecture, this condo epitomizes upscale city living. Enjoy easy access to the array of restaurants and shops on Chestnut, the Palace of Fine Arts, and Marina Green.
